title: Graph snapshot restore's open-descendant validation visits every snapshot item once per root
outcome: Graph snapshot restore's open-descendant validation visits every snapshot item once per root
acceptance: Graph snapshot restore validates each root's open-descendant limit in time linear in the snapshot's items, proven by a test whose row-visit count does not grow with the number of roots times items
Restore still refuses a snapshot whose root exceeds the open-descendant limit

completion.summary: Graph snapshot restore now validates each root's open-descendant limit in one pass: src/storage/graph_snapshot/load.rs builds the item map once after the duplicate-and-shape loop, uses it for the parent lookup (formerly a linear find per item), and after the parent-chain walk counts proposed and open non-root items grouped by root_id, refusing with the unchanged message; the phase order is unchanged, so a document with both a bad depth and an excessive count keeps the depth refusal. Proven by tests/hierarchy_limits.rs with a thread-local test-only visit counter: six equal-size shapes (64 roots × 3, 1 × 255, 256 roots only, 1 × 255 cancelled, 32 × 3, 1 × 127) each cost exactly their item count, against roots × items for the old shape; an injected 256th open or proposed child is refused with no partial state while 255 open with 16 cancelled loads; depth-before-count, malformed root binding, cross-root child and the empty graph are covered. Docs state restore's cost once beside the planning sentence. Landed with w-37a24b8cccb3 and w-987b34f92b57 as 7340a475c1ac9cc1c857bb5a0c04ddb2bae9307c on origin master (fast-forward from 73c0f8d, pushed 2026-10-06T05:53:51Z); full gate test-6b8532a2 9/9 on freeze 5d82c31f… (nine gates recorded); round-2 pair clean of Medium or higher, the shared Low filed as w-ae1fe23de0b6; evaluation 7df419edd71442e7b6b65aa1a3f919f8 passed both criteria; readiness ready on all four live stores with the build from the commit; installed build c1f7f82e2853 (exe 29ec899ee953…), previous exe backed up as engram-20261006T055332Z-ca8a56871983.exe. Running sessions do not need this build: it changes only the cost of restore validation, which runs on graph load; no durable row, schema or projection change.
